# Integration Test Fixtures

Golden `.expected.html` files are generated by Asciidoctor 2.0.26 using:

```bash
asciidoctor -o <name>.expected.html -s <name>.adoc
```

The `-s` flag produces standalone body content (no full HTML document wrapper).

To regenerate all golden files:

```bash
cd tests/fixtures/integration
for f in *.adoc; do
  asciidoctor -o "${f%.adoc}.expected.html" -s "$f"
done
```

Do NOT generate expected output with AdocNet.
